posts.name: diff-tour

posts.description: PrayForMe is an AI temple for all faiths: a private illustrated garden where AI helpers create personal prayers or good wishes for your intentions. Choose secular good wishes, Christian prayer or Buddhist loving-kindness. Your first prayer or wish is free, with no account or card. Paid gardens keep returning to your intentions on a schedule, even when you close the page.

posts.tagline: Save ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini chats to your computer
posts.description: Every conversation with ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, saved to your computer and searchable in one place.

posts.tagline: A full video editor that runs in your browser
posts.description: Free online & offline video editor, no sign up. Trim, cut, merge and crop MP4, MOV, MKV and WebM in your browser. An offline video cutter for large files - your video never leaves your device

posts.tagline: Global news API for developers and AI agents

posts.tagline: Generate, edit and burn AI captions in your browser

Choose between Fast, Balanced, and Accurate AI models, edit captions directly, and export SRT, VTT, or plain-text transcripts. No signup, no watermark, no per-minute charges, & no file uploads. Your videos, audio, and transcripts never leave your device.

posts.name: Granily
posts.tagline: Care home software that gives teams more time for care
posts.description: Granily is care home software for managers and caregivers. It brings resident records, medication, tasks, care notes, incidents, handovers and audit trails into one place. Managers get oversight through the web app, while caregivers can record and access what they need from mobile during a shift. The aim is to reduce paperwork, keep important information easy to find and make daily care and inspection preparation simpler.

posts.name: Love Envelope
posts.tagline: Make love invitations worth opening.

posts.description: A voice-first calorie tracker for Apple Watch and iPhone. Say what you ate and it logs the calories, protein, carbs and fat.

posts.tagline: Everything you need to put your product on the internet
posts.description: Rimbra is the all-in-one platform to put a product on the internet: app hosting from GitHub, managed PostgreSQL, MySQL and Redis, domains with automatic HTTPS, an Email API and Social notifications, in one account with one bill.

posts.name: Tenacove
posts.tagline: Your rental record, from move-in to move-out
posts.description: Tenacove helps US renters keep rental photos and notes in one place. Follow room-by-room checklists, compare move-in and move-out conditions, and export original photos with a readable report. Prepare email drafts and a Markdown brief for your personal agent. Start free; the optional Lease Pass costs $19 once for 12 months, with no automatic renewal. Try the sample without an account.

posts.name: AntiTic AI
posts.tagline: Detect & strip AI slop from text with deterministic linting
posts.description: Stop sounding like ChatGPT. AntiTic detects over 80 dead giveaways of AI prose (delve, tapestry, crucial, beacon) and rewrites your copy with real, grounded human voice.

posts.name: InboxMail
posts.tagline: Custom-domain email for teams and AI agents

posts.name: Porvi
posts.tagline: Trip plans built around you, with all the logistics handled
posts.description: Porvi turns your city, dates and travel style into a day-by-day plan on a map. Tell it who you're traveling with, your pace and what you love, and every route is built around that. Every stop is checked against its opening hours, with metro rides, walks and meals timed from your hotel and back, plus a note on why it fits you. Don't like a day? Ask for a change and compare before you keep it. The first day of every trip is free, then pay per trip. No subscription.

posts.tagline: Open source - Agentic AI platform

posts.name: LeadLamp
posts.tagline: Find out why your email lands in spam and fix it for free
posts.description: LeadLamp checks your DMARC, SPF, DKIM, MX and blacklists live, then tells you in plain English what’s stopping your email reaching the inbox. See if you pass the Gmail, Yahoo and Outlook rules, get the exact record to add, and follow the steps for your DNS company. If someone else looks after your DNS, send them the steps in one click. Free, no sign-up to scan, and free domain watch emails you if anything changes.

posts.name: Warsita
posts.tagline: The WhatsApp API that doesn't charge per message
posts.description: Send WhatsApp broadcasts from a dashboard or messages from your app with a REST API and webhooks. Link numbers by QR code, rotate senders; unlimited messages, priced per number.
